title: FM27 Release Date — Out 10 November 2026 on PC, Mac, Console & Mobile
description: Football Manager 27 released on 10 November 2026: PC and Mac on Steam, Epic, Microsoft Store and Game Pass; console on Xbox and PS5; Touch on Apple Arcade; Mobile on Netflix. Price, editions and save carry-over.
meta: Updated 13 November 2026 · FM27 released 10 November 2026 at 16:00 UK time · Steam release date and US price re-read 13 November 2026.
body:
Football Manager 27 is out. It released on 10 November 2026 at 16:00 UK time, across every supported platform at once, and the Launch Preview saves carried into it. This page is now a reference for what shipped, on which edition, and at what price — not a countdown.

Per edition

EditionPlatformsRelease dateNotes
FM27 (PC/Mac)Steam, Epic Games Store, Microsoft Store, Xbox PC app10 November 2026Included with PC Game Pass and Game Pass Ultimate; Launch Preview saves carry over
FM27 ConsoleXbox Series X|S, PlayStation 510 November 2026 (digital)Included with Game Pass Console; PS5 physical on 20 November
FM27 TouchApple Arcade — iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV10 November 2026Subscription title, not a separate purchase
FM27 MobileNetflix10 November 2026Subscription title
Pre-Game Editor / In-Game EditorPC and MacReleased alongside launchAnnounced with the launch-day post, not before

Price

Steam's US listing shows $59.99 with no launch discount when read on 13 November 2026. The UK retail price quoted by Sports Interactive's product FAQ is £49.99. The 10% Launch Preview pre-purchase discount applied to pre-orders through SEGA-approved retailers and expired with the release; check your own store for the current regional price, because they do not all track each other.

Saves carry over

Sports Interactive states that a save started in the free Launch Preview continues into the paid Preview and the full release. That also means a Preview save is not a clean slate: if you want the released database as-is, start a new save rather than continuing.

What changed at launch, in one table

Before releaseNow
Free Launch Preview, 29 October–3 NovemberClosed. No free play window is running.
Paid Preview for pre-purchasersReplaced by the released game.
Pre-Game and In-Game Editor due “at launch”Released with the game on PC and Mac.
“Some assets awaiting rights-holder approval”Still true in general — a missing licensed badge is not proof of a broken install.

If you are starting now

  1. Install the real-name fix before you start a long save — it is save-game compatible, but doing it first avoids re-checking names later.
  2. Add logos and a skin one at a time, so a broken screen has one cause.
  3. Read the wonderkid values as database numbers, then scout them in your own save.
  4. Leave the tactics page open if you plan to import a community tactic — most of the work is verifying the claim, not downloading the file.
